actions.text: A young man materializes on a bridge with a digital glitch effect.
He looks down at his hands and body to inspect himself.
He walks forward across the bridge.

camera.text: Medium shot, static, framed between a lamppost and a foreground structure.
Pan right, tracking the man as he walks.

analysis.performance_note: The actor effectively conveys the initial confusion of materializing followed by a transition to a purposeful walk.
analysis.summary: A young man materializes on a bridge via a digital glitch effect. He checks his hands and body before walking forward across the bridge.
